svg.title: Register an aircraft whose model is owned by another replica (US102) — checks on the read models

g.text: Register an aircraft whose model is owned by another replica (US102) — checks on the read models
model "A330" exists? (owned by replica 2, known by its event)
saveAndFlush(new Aircraft) — replica 1 becomes the owner
apply to the local read model (same transaction)
AircraftRegistered (after commit) → other replicas, Flight Routes, unicorns
No peer call. Inside the consistency window (an aircraft registered on another replica
whose event has not arrived yet) a duplicate can slip through — the accepted price of AP.
